title: IDD Forced Handoff Parsed Payload
description: Normalized camelCase payload returned by parseForcedHandoffComment; raw on-wire marker JSON may use hyphen-case aliases that the parser resolves before schema validation.

oldAgentId.description: Agent identifier of the claim being handed off.

oldClaimId.description: Claim identifier of the claim being handed off.

newAgentId.description: Agent identifier named as the successor of the handoff.

newClaimId.description: Claim identifier adopted by the successor.

branch.description: Branch that remains associated with the transferred claim.

linkedPr.description: PR number or URL used to bind an issue-plus-pr handoff to its backing pull request.

forcedBy.description: Actor recorded as authorizing the forced handoff; callers verify that actor’s authority.

reason.description: Human-readable reason recorded for the handoff.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp embedded in the forced-handoff marker.

contextScope.description: Scope in which the handoff is intended to be honored.

createdAt.description: GitHub comment creation timestamp used to order and validate the handoff.
